title: Copper French Quarter Gas Lantern Installation in St. Louis (This Old House)

locations.name: St. Louis, Missouri, USA
locations.basis: Transcript explicitly situates activity in St. Louis ('Thanks for coming to St. Louis'; 'in St. Louis' references).

locations.name: New Orleans, Louisiana, USA (design inspiration)
locations.basis: Transcript references 'French Quarter design' and 'New Orleans style' as inspiration for the lantern.

summary: This This Old House episode documents the exterior installation of a copper, New Orleans–inspired (French Quarter) gas lantern on a building in St. Louis. The team describes the lantern’s design cues (copper construction, fleur‑de‑lis motifs), plans routing a gas line from an interior source to the exterior, and coordinates with a licensed gas fitter and the local gas utility. The project proceeds with panel access to conceal the line, masonry drilling to pass the line, and running a 1/4‑inch copper tube down the wall to the basement before mounting the lantern on a gooseneck bracket, purging the line, and lighting a decorative pilot flame. The video emphasizes safety, planning, and the aesthetic integration of a classic lantern in a Midwestern urban setting, with a nighttime payoff anticipated.

sections.title: Lantern description and style

sections.title: Site planning and gas line access
sections.description: Planning where to place the lantern and how to route the gas line from inside to outside, including considerations for mounting height.

sections.title: Panel access and slack planning
sections.description: Removing a panel to gain access to the internal gas line and ensuring there is sufficient slack for final connections.

sections.title: Final gas connections prep
sections.description: Preparation for final gas connections, including readiness to connect and the approach to turn on the gas safely.

sections.title: Gas purge and ignition demonstration
sections.description: The crew purges the line, explains air removal, and demonstrates turning on the decorative pilot flame with a note on low gas usage and anticipated nighttime appearance.

sections.title: Wrap-up and expectations
sections.description: Concluding remarks and anticipation of the lantern's improved appearance after dark.
